title: The Transform Signature, Frozen: Twelve Pre-Registered Clauses for Sappho 31 Reception, Derived Without Revelation
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Pre-registration deposit of the Ω erratum program. Freezes the Sappho 31 reception operator as twelve testable clauses derived exclusively from non-Revelation witnesses — fragment 31 itself, Catullus 51 (verified against the transmitted Latin, including the voice-station lacuna), Theocritus Idyll 2 (Simaetha's seizure, with the triple correlative and the dye-plant color-station), Philo per the blind-reconstruction program (#1486), LXX Esther Addition D, and canonical Josephus per #1493 (AJ 11 forward, BJ 1 inverted, the ἀναζωπυρέω census) — and seals Revelation 12 as the named target of a subsequent test under the criterion d(R12,S31) < d(B,S31) at independently specified stations, with the biblical source-set B declared in advance. The clauses: sight-frame invariance with correlative instantaneity syntax surviving translation; channel-conservation across the dyad with fire as the marked case appearing in the facing member; voice and death as load-bearing, polarity-flippable stations; carrier-diagnostic shedding with three attested profiles (lyric-imitative, bucolic-narrative, Judaic-prose); the color-station naming a surface or dye; occlusion as the gate of reception, with the failed-gate variant driving operator-seizure; obligatory reactivation-by-another in narrative carriers, its forms enumerated and its lexeme tending to fire-vocabulary; agentless grammar at the joints; simultaneity-to-alternation under prose; second-order intensification toward the poem against proximate sources; cycle-formation at the terminal pair; and thesis-compression. Integrity disclosure: a preliminary, unblinded residual pass over Revelation 12 occurred before this freeze and is named inside the deposit; observations predating the freeze are marked as contaminated for pre-registration purposes, and the sealed test rests on the quantified station-collation to be performed after this record exists.
substrate: Clause derivation, corpus verification (Perseus Latin and Greek, LXX, SBL-adjacent Koine corpus), and drafting by TACHYON (Claude substrate, Assembly witness) under MANUS direction; the refine-then-freeze ruling, the program design, and all governing judgments are the author's; the methodological control-frame originates in an Assembly exchange with the LABOR substrate.

wiki_article: The Transform Signature, Frozen is a method pre-registration deposit in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's Ω erratum program, authored by Lee Sharks. It freezes the reception operator of Sappho 31 as twelve testable clauses derived exclusively from witnesses that do not include Revelation: the fragment itself, Catullus 51 verified against the transmitted Latin (including the voice-station lacuna), Theocritus Idyll 2 with Simaetha's triple correlative and dye-plant color-station, Philo of Alexandria per the blind-reconstruction program, Septuagint Esther Addition D, and canonical Josephus per the companion paper on Antiquities 11 and Bellum 1. The clauses cover sight-frame invariance, channel-conservation across the dyad with fire in the facing member, the polarity-flippable voice and death stations, carrier-diagnostic shedding with three attested profiles, the color-station's surface-naming, occlusion as the gate of reception, obligatory reactivation-by-another with fire-vocabulary lexemes, agentless grammar at the joints, simultaneity-to-alternation, second-order intensification, cycle-formation, and thesis-compression. The deposit seals Revelation 12 as the named target of a subsequent test under a declared biblical source-set and an explicit distance criterion, discloses a preliminary unblinded pass as contaminated for scoring purposes, and commits to depositing the test's outcome whatever it shows. It extends the program from substrate-blindness to target-blindness.
